mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_dictionary_word_state ( user_id, word, normalized_word, language, source, favorite, lookup_count, first_lookup_at, last_lookup_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{word}, #{normalizedWord}, #{language}, #{source}, 0, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE word = VALUES(word), language = VALUES(language), source = VALUES(source), lookup_count = lookup_count + 1, last_lookup_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO user_dictionary_word_state ( user_id, word, normalized_word, language, source, favorite, lookup_count, favorited_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{word}, #{normalizedWord}, #{language}, 'manual', #{favorite}, 0, CASE WHEN #{favorite} THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE word = VALUES(word), language = VALUES(language), favorite = VALUES(favorite), favorited_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(favorite) = 1 THEN COALESCE(favorited_at, NOW()) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, word, normalized_word, language, source, favorite, lookup_count, favorited_at, last_lookup_at FROM user_dictionary_word_state WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND normalized_word = #{normalizedWord} LIMIT 1
